title: Verify that a logged-in user can successfully log out and is redirected back to the login page
preconditions: User is not authenticated (begins from the login page, or has an active session that can be terminated by logging out first)
Valid demo credentials available: email 'manish123@gmail.com', password 'Manish9@@'

testSteps.action: Navigate to https://eventhub.rahulshettyacademy.com/ and wait for the login form to be visible
Enter the demo email into the user email input (placeholder 'you@email.com')
Enter the demo password into the password input (placeholder '••••••')
Click the 'Sign In' button and wait for the post-login app shell to render (URL changes away from /login and the top navigation is visible)
Verify the user is authenticated (Events tab is visible in the top nav and the URL does not contain '/login')
Click the user/profile menu in the top-right of the app shell to open the account dropdown
testSteps.testData: Locator: profileMenuButton (button near top-right of the header)

testSteps.action: Verify a dropdown appears containing at least a 'Logout' (or 'Sign out', 'Log out') action item
Click the 'Logout' item in the dropdown
testSteps.testData: Locator: dropdown item with visible text matching /log\s*out|sign\s*out/i

testSteps.action: Wait for the post-logout redirect to complete and observe the URL and visible UI
Verify the user is redirected back to the login page (URL ends with '/login' or matches the login route) and the login form is visible
Verify the previously authenticated app shell (top navigation, Events tab, My Bookings tab) is no longer visible

Click the browser Back button once and verify that the previous authenticated page is not accessible without re-authentication (the user is forced back to the login page, or the protected route is not re-rendered with the prior session)

expectedResult: The user can successfully log out from a logged-in session. The user/profile dropdown reveals a Logout option; clicking it terminates the session and redirects the user back to the EventHub login page. The login form is visible again, the authenticated app shell (top nav with Events / My Bookings) is gone, and the protected route is no longer reachable with the prior session when the Back button is pressed (no stale authenticated state is shown).
